in Bengali and English in other areas.
(3) The alphabetical order as referred to in sub-section
(2) shall be determined with reference to the
surnames of the candidates where the surnames are
written first. In other cases, proper names of the
candidates shall be considered for determining the
alphabetical order.
(4) Where a poll becomes necessary, the Panchayat
Returning Officer shall consider the choice of
symbols expressed by the contesting candidates in
their nomination papers and shall, -
(a) allot a different symbol to each contesting
candidate in conformity, as far as practicable,
with his choice;
(b) if more than one contesting candidate have
indicated their preference for the same symbol,
